checkedAlternates.risk: Sabre is one of the three Olympic fencing weapons.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sabre scores with both the blade edge and tip (group-1), whereas Foil and Épée score only with the tip (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Sabre fencers wear a metallic lamé jacket.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The lamé is conductive scoring apparel (group-3), not a weapon (group-1).
